name: preprocess-receipt-image
description: Sandbox (Docker) script. Takes a base64 image, auto-orients it, converts to grayscale, stretches contrast (normalize + a gentle linear boost), sharpens faded thermal print, and downscales the long edge to maxEdge. Emits receipt-pre.jpg, which the engine serves under /files/ so the vision node can fetch it. Requires Docker running on the host.

inputs.name: imageB64
inputs.description: Base64-encoded source image (from a read-file node, format=base64).

inputs.name: maxEdge
inputs.description: Max length of the longest edge in pixels; image is downscaled to fit. Default 1600.
